micro.name: Pololu 2359 700:1 sub-micro plastic planetary gearmotor 6D x 21L

D.note: with one station per gap between the yokes only the cross pose fits; 2+2, 3+1 and one side need re-grabs

E.verdict: leg passes through the rotor-side pull ring and sweeps through the static yokes in flight

F.power: 5 rotor-side copper tracks under the cage flange (common + 1 per motor), phosphor-bronze wiper on each leg; 5 spring pogo pins on the lift ring touch the tracks only while parked (est.)

G.verdict: 2 mm between the pull-ring rail top (z 89) and the base disc (z 91)
